mapper.select: SELECT walEnabled, dedup FROM tables() WHERE table_name = 'product_property_${productId}'
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE product_property_${productId} ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "${column.name}" ${column.type}
mapper.select: SELECT "${columnName}" AS "value", CAST(ts AS LONG) / 1000 AS update_time FROM product_property_${productId} WHERE device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ts >= CAST(#{startTime,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TIMESTAMP) AND ts <= CAST(#{endTime,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TIMESTAMP) AND "${columnName}" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC
